title: Valuation Table for Denied Units on Reviewed Remittances — Insulin Pump Program
content:
In the review of a remittance posting on an Insulin Pump Program, the value of a denied unit of the reviewed line follows the remittance:

| What the remittance and its claim show | Effect on the standard value of a denied unit |
|---|---|
| The remittance itemizes an allowed amount | replaced with that allowed amount divided by the line's units |
| It itemizes no allowed amount, but the claim shows a billed amount | replaced with that billed amount divided by the line's units |
| Neither | the standard value stands |

The line's units are the units of the shipment the remittance's claim bills; the billed amount is that of the claim the remittance answers.

**Worked values (hypothetical line of 30 units):** an allowed amount of $205.50 gives $6.85 a unit; with no allowed amount and a billed amount of $240.00, $8.00 a unit.
